notes: Lead profile: small SaaS team building agent-first helpdesk widget embedded in customer sites.
Primary concern right now = latency for EU end-users. They signed up self-serve, low monthly spend but high sensitivity to UX.
They used hosted_api out-of-the-box; default region was us-east. EU testers hitting cross-region latency ~800-1200ms which they flagged as unacceptable.
Quote from product lead: 'If responses take more than ~400ms the chat feels slow — we lose user attention.'

SE notes from 2026-03-01 call: immediate wins = (1) enable region selection to nearest region, (2) use streaming response path in SDK, (3) tweak client-side timeout/retry and optimistic UI UX, (4) shorten prefix and trim system prompt tokens for chat sessions.
Suggested POC acceptance criteria: p50 < 200ms and p95 < 450ms for 200 concurrent simulated chat sessions in chosen region. POC to run 48 hours with controlled replay.

Prompt guidance given: move static context to embeddings or short metadata, limit system prompt to 40-80 tokens, send relevant user history only (last 2-3 turns), batch reranking asynchronously when possible.

Timeout/connection guidance: client socket read timeout = 30s default; recommend application-level response timeout = 3s for first token then stream remainder, fallback to compact-summary mode at 2.5s if no token arrives.

Routing guidance: enable smart routing policy for EU traffic to eu-west region; configure policy to fallback to us-west if eu capacity saturated with throttling signal. Consider caching frequent prefixes at edge.
Cost note: shorter prompts saved ~20% tokens in our sample run; customer is cost-sensitive but prioritizes UX. Discussed Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching vs latency tradeoffs.
Security: they asked for SOC2 checklist and how audit logs are surfaced; awaiting SSO metadata to test SAML (blocker).

Action items we own: provide a short 'latency playbook' doc (drive link), set up test API key scoped to us-west, run 48h POC with scripted load and share perf graphs, create minimal prompt templates for their UI.
Customer action items: provide SSO test credentials, confirm production region preference after POC, decide whether to accept streaming model in embedded widget UX.
Internal: potential expansion to Dedicated later if traffic grows and they need predictable p95 SLAs; for now SMB hosted_api fits their budget. Keep in touch re: monthly usage thresholds.
